summary: Silicom Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and management review for the six months ended June 30, 2026, attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. No transactional event is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or capital action. The filing is an ordinary semi-annual earnings release, incorporated by reference into effective registration statements, and signed by CFO Eran Gilad. No deal terms, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock apply. What to watch is operating performance, customer concentration, and treasury-share activity, not event-driven arbitrage.
